description: Researchers at Qufu Normal University and partner institutions derive heatwave and drought indicators for the middle and lower Yangtze River from daily weather observations during 1961–2020. Measures include event days, frequency and maximum duration, summarised by station, province and study period. The ScienceDB repository describes six XLS data files and a supporting figure under CC BY 4.0 for free reuse. These indicators can support historical hazard baselines and stress-test assumptions for water and other infrastructure simulations. Threshold-defined events do not measure asset damage, and station/province summaries provide limited detail for individual facilities. Users must retain the authors’ definitions of heatwaves and effective precipitation when comparing datasets. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
name: Data set of heat wave and drought indicators in the middle and lower reaches of the Yangtze River from 1961 to 2020
